## Deputies Elections

There have been 7 elections (6 contested) for Deputy held in St Saviour No 2 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (2 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Alan Breckon](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-breckon) and [Lyndon Farnham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham) were elected as Deputies of St Saviour No 2 in 2002 unopposed.**
